_rule: Declared gaps between computed anchor load and the hand-set live board. An entry here does NOT make the mismatch correct — it records that the hand-set number is known-unsupported and frozen. The gate downgrades a matching gap to WARN; any change in the numbers (drift) still FAILs. Remove an entry the moment the hand-set number is corrected or the panel retires at cutover.
